transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Thank you. Well... what scared me enough to come in today is that I keep having these thoughts. I just keep thinking it would be a relief if I didn't wake up. I haven't tried to hurt myself or anything like that, but... just thinking that way over and over really frightened me, so I figured I needed to see someone.
Besides having those thoughts, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or empty lately?
Yes, I have. Most mornings, I wake up with this heavy sadness right in my chest. It just feels like... well, like I already failed the day before it even starts.
How long have you been feeling this heavy sadness?
It's been going on for about four months now. It started right around the time my aunt came to live with us.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in the things you normally enjoy doing?

Yes, I really have. I used to look forward to doing my watercolors, going to dance class, and walking with the ladies. But lately... well, I just leave my painting things sitting out. I just can't seem to make myself care about doing any of it anymore.
Have you ever had a time in the past where you felt this depressed and low?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had sad days before, just like anyone else, but... never anything like this. This is really the first time I've ever felt this low and just couldn't shake it off.
Have you ever experienced a period where you felt the opposite—extremely energetic, euphoric, or irritable, with much less need for sleep than usual?

No, I haven't. I don't think I've ever had a time like that. I've never been the type to have too much energy or go without my regular sleep. I've always just felt... well, pretty normal, I guess, right up until this heavy feeling started a few months ago. So no, nothing like what you're describing.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns since this started, such as trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or sleeping too much?

No, I haven't really noticed any changes there. My sleep is... well, it's been pretty much the same as always. I go to bed at my usual time and sleep through. I haven't had any trouble falling asleep, and I'm not sleeping the day away or anything like that, no.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy during this time?

Yes, I have. Even after getting a full night in bed, my body just feels worn out. It's like... well, just doing regular things around the house, like carrying the laundry or making breakfast, it takes a lot more out of me than it should. I just don't have the energy for it anymore.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite recently?

No, not really. I mean, my appetite has been pretty much the same. I still eat my regular meals every day. I haven't noticed being extra hungry or losing my taste for food or anything, so... no, no changes there.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or feeling guilty about things lately?

Yes, I have. Sometimes, especially when I'm feeling so tired or if I get annoyed with my aunt... I just start thinking that I'm a bad woman. It makes me feel like I'm bringing shame on my family, because I know I should be more grateful. But instead, I just feel awful and guilty about it.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating, focusing your thoughts, or making everyday decisions?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. My mind feels clear enough. I mean, I can still focus on whatever I'm doing, like if I'm watching TV or sorting through the mail. And making everyday decisions... no, that hasn't been a problem for me. I just don't have the energy to do much, but my thoughts are fine.
